subject: RDMA: Support .is_local method (#1089)
reason: The change only adds an .is_local implementation to the RDMA connection type in src/rdma.c. That code is compiled only with BUILD_RDMA=module (not in the default build the fuzzer uses), is loaded via MODULE LOAD (refused in sequences), and runs only on a live RDMA connection, which needs RDMA hardware or root-configured soft-RoCE that these unprivileged local runs do not have. No installed or writable experiment can open an RDMA connection, so connRdmaIsLocal is unreachable and no scenario can test it.
